data.title: Bellavista
data.about:
Welcome to Bellavista by Damac. Located in Damac Hills, Bellavista has the most mesmerising views of the lush green Trump Championship golf course and the iconic Dubai’s skyline. Offering beautifully designed studios and 1 & 2 bedroom apartments, Bellavista is the perfect place for you to find your new home.

Living in Bellavista promises you an unparalleled lifestyle. YOu will have access to not just the exquisite golf course, but also the best amenities you can ask for. Surrounded by green fairways and enclaves, you also have a clubhouse. Residents also have access to temperature-controlled swimming pools, gym, sauna and steam rooms, cricket grounds, retail outlets, supermarkets, schools, nurseries, as well as running tracks, tennis courts, barbecue areas and more.

characteristics_module.title: Expanses of Parks and Cricket Grounds
characteristics_module.description:
• 18-hole championship golf course with green fairways & enclaves

  • Nearby schools, nursery, Spinneys and Carrefour

  • State-of-the-art gymnasium
  • Hospital & Clinic
  • Steam room and sauna
  • Ample parking

location_tile.title: Where Your Dreams Come True
location_tile.description: A master development with everything you’ll need, DAMAC Hills oﬀers little reason for you to venture away from home. However, with a convenient location close to major road networks, you’ll ﬁnd the city centre within easy reach.
